plain_summary: Review antipsychotic treatment supplied before a child's sixth birthday.

medicine_groups.name: Antipsychotics
medicine_groups.note: Count oral and injectable antipsychotics. Flupentixol decanoate is the depot form of flupentixol. Count a matching supply once under either ingredient name. For a medicine also used for nausea or vomiting, check why this supply was prescribed.

rule_for_models: Use age on the supply date. From the sixth birthday give no finding. If age is unknown, give no finding and ask for the age. Before six, flag antipsychotic treatment and cite the supply and any evidence of its purpose. Check the indication for formulations also used for nausea or vomiting, including prochlorperazine, chlorpromazine, haloperidol and droperidol. Accept a record or pharmacist answer about this supply. Exclude any supply confirmed to be for another purpose, including olanzapine for vomiting. If the indication is unclear, give only a possible finding and ask the pharmacist to confirm it.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm why this medicine was prescribed and review its use as antipsychotic treatment in this child under six?

needs_facts.what: Reason for this antipsychotic supply before the sixth birthday
needs_facts.meets: When the indication needs checking, either a record or the pharmacist can confirm the reason for this supply. Antipsychotic treatment qualifies. Another purpose excludes the supply. An unknown reason leaves it open.

This supply was for nausea or vomiting
